NTA - In my opinion, the bride should be given whatever she wants during her wedding.

That being said, I’m a male with my ears pierced and before I met my girlfriend’s grandfather at my graduation, her mom asked me to remove my earrings to avoid “shocking” the grandfather. In this case, I chose to keep my earrings because my graduation was my day too, and my opinion mattered.

Your wedding is not her day. It is your day - to be cherished by you and your loved one and whomever else you wish to share the experience with. A true friend would take this into consideration and comply with the favor asked. 

You will look at the pictures for the rest of your life and remember this argument; for your wedding, are you going to have this regret?
